import pathlib,re
for f in sorted(pathlib.Path('.').glob('*.txt')):
 s=f.read_text().replace('\\xa0',' ')
 for p in re.split(r'--- page (\\d+) ---',s)[1:][::2]: pass
 a=re.split(r'--- page (\\d+) ---',s)
 for n,p in zip(a[1::2],a[2::2]):
  p=' '.join(p.split())
  for m in re.finditer(r'favou?r\\w*|\\bMFN\\b|(?:lowest|best|same|better|equivalent|preferential) (?:price|pricing|terms|rates|discount)|(?:terms|prices|rates|pricing).{0,55}(?:offered to|charged to|granted to)',p,re.I):
   print(f.name,n,p[max(0,m.start()-48):m.end()+90])
PY"
